# AI-DLC - AI-Driven Development Life Cycle

Run `/aidlc` to start or resume a workflow. Describe what to build and AI-DLC proposes a plan for you to confirm.

**Phases** (36 stages across 8 phases):

| Phase          | Stages        | Focus                                            |
|----------------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| INITIALIZATION | 0.1-0.3 (3)   | Bootstrap state, scaffold dirs, detect workspace |
| DISCOVER       | 1.1-1.8 (8)   | Validate intent, scope, feasibility, team        |
| DESIGN         | 2.1-2.12 (12) | Practices, requirements, design, planning        |
| BUILD          | 3.1 (1)       | Generate code, per unit                          |
| TEST           | 4.1-4.2 (2)   | Build, test, performance                         |
| SECURE         | 5.1-5.3 (3)   | Code, security and conformance review            |
| DEPLOY         | 6.1-6.4 (4)   | CI, pipelines, environments, deploy              |
| OPERATE        | 7.1-7.3 (3)   | Observe, respond, optimise                       |

**Stages:**

| Phase    | Stages                                                                                  |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| DISCOVER | IC=Intent Capture · MR=Market Research · FS=Feasibility · SD=Scope Definition           |
|          | TF=Team Formation · RM=Rough Mockups · AH=Approval Handoff · RE=Reverse Engineering     |
| DESIGN   | RA=Requirements Analysis · US=User Stories · PD=Practices Discovery · DD=Domain Design  |
|          | CD=Contract Design · RF=Refined Mockups · UG=Units Generation · DL=Delivery Planning    |
|          | FD=Functional Design · NR=NFR Requirements · ND=NFR Design · ID=Infrastructure Design   |
| BUILD    | CG=Code Generation                                                                      |
| TEST     | BT=Build & Test · PV=Performance Validation                                             |
| SECURE   | CR=Code Review · SR=Security Review · CO=Conformance Review                             |
| DEPLOY   | CI=CI Pipeline · DP=Deployment Pipeline · EP=Env Provisioning · DE=Deployment Execution |
| OPERATE  | OS=Observability Setup · IR=Incident Response · FO=Feedback & Optimization              |

**Scopes** (INIT 0.1-0.3 always runs):

| Scope          | Depth         | DISCOVER           | DESIGN             | BUILD | TEST | SECURE | DEPLOY | OPERATE |
|----------------|---------------|--------------------|--------------------|-------|------|--------|--------|---------|
| enterprise     | Comprehensive | all                | all                | all   | all  | all    | all    | all     |
| feature        | Standard      | all                | all                | all   | all  | CR, SR | all    | all     |
| mvp            | Standard      | IC, FS, SD, RM, RE | all                | all   | BT   | CR, SR | CI     | -       |
| poc            | Minimal       | IC, RE             | RA                 | all   | BT   | CR, SR | -      | -       |
| bugfix         | Minimal       | RE                 | RA                 | all   | BT   | CR, SR | DP, DE | -       |
| refactor       | Minimal       | RE                 | RA, FD             | all   | BT   | CR, SR | DP, DE | -       |
| infra          | Standard      | -                  | RA, PD, NR, ND, ID | all   | BT   | all    | all    | OS      |
| security-patch | Minimal       | RE                 | RA, NR             | all   | BT   | all    | DP, DE | -       |
| classic        | Standard      | RE                 | all                | all   | BT   | all    | -      | -       |
| workshop       | Standard      | RE                 | all                | all   | all  | CR, SR | all    | all     |
| express        | Minimal       | RE                 | RA                 | all   | BT   | CR, SR | DP, DE | OS      |

**Workflow**

1. Scope is set from your command, or proposed from what you describe for you to confirm.
2. Stages execute in order, with appropriate agents leading each one.
3. At every approval gate, you review output and decide whether to approve, revise, or skip.
4. Artifacts are saved under the active intent record in `aidlc/spaces/<space>/intents/<record>/` for review at any time.

**Tips**
- Describe your task in plain English: AI-DLC proposes the scope and plan for you to confirm
- Run `/aidlc --status` to check progress at any time
- Run `/aidlc --stage <id>` or `/aidlc --phase <name>` to jump ahead
- Run `/aidlc --help` for full usage and examples
